Usage:
  riltra [--help] [--version] status
  riltra init --repo <path> [--name <name>]
  riltra repo list
  riltra repo status --repo <name>
  riltra doctor [--repo <name>]
  riltra scan --repo <name> [--path <relpath>]... [--symbol <substr>]
  riltra index --repo <name> [--full]
  riltra index status --repo <name>
  riltra search --repo <name> --symbol <substr> [--limit <n>] [--offset <n>]
  riltra semantic import --repo <name> --scip <file> [--source-digest <hex>]
  riltra semantic status --repo <name>
  riltra semantic query --repo <name> --path <rel> --line <n> --col <n> [--refs] [--lsp-server <abs-path>]
  riltra callers --repo <name> --path <rel> --line <n> --col <n> [--symbol <uri>] [--limit <n>] [--offset <n>]
  riltra callees --repo <name> --path <rel> --line <n> --col <n> [--symbol <uri>] [--limit <n>] [--offset <n>]
  riltra trace --repo <name> --path <rel> --line <n> --col <n> [--symbol <uri>] [--to <path:line:col>] [--depth <n>] [--limit <n>] [--offset <n>]
  riltra impact --repo <name> --path <rel> --line <n> --col <n> [--symbol <uri>] [--depth <n>] [--limit <n>] [--offset <n>]
  riltra knowledge create --repo <name> --input -
  riltra knowledge show --repo <name> --id <id> [--revision <n>]
  riltra knowledge update --repo <name> --id <id> --expected-revision <n> --input -
  riltra knowledge history --repo <name> --id <id> [--limit <n>] [--offset <n>] [--generation <n>]
  riltra knowledge search --repo <name> --query <text> [--kind <kind>] [--include-archived] [--include-superseded] [--include-retracted] [--limit <n>] [--offset <n>] [--generation <n>]
  riltra knowledge link --repo <name> --input -
  riltra knowledge unlink --repo <name> --relation <id> --input -
  riltra knowledge related --repo <name> --id <id> [--revision <n>] [--direction inbound|outbound] [--include-retracted] [--limit <n>] [--offset <n>] [--generation <n>]
  riltra knowledge export --repo <name> [--format jsonl|md] [--out <path>]
  riltra knowledge import --repo <name> --file <path>
  riltra knowledge backup --repo <name> --out <path>
  riltra knowledge restore --repo <name> --file <path> [--overwrite]
  riltra knowledge verify --repo <name>
  riltra mcp

Commands:
  status       Print deterministic bootstrap status as JSON
  init         Register a local repository root
  repo list    List registered repositories as JSON
  repo status  Git/worktree fingerprint of a registered repository
  doctor       Path-security and repository health checks as JSON
  scan         Syntax facts (definitions/imports/calls) as JSON
  index        Build the durable code index for a repository
  index status Report index freshness (fresh/stale/unknown) as JSON
  search       Search indexed symbols as JSON
  semantic import Import a SCIP index against the live snapshot as JSON
  semantic status Per-provider binding verification as JSON
  semantic query Single-hop definition/reference lookup as JSON
  callers Direct callers of the anchored identity as JSON
  callees Direct callees of the anchored identity as JSON
  trace Bounded plausible static paths with per-hop evidence
  impact Conservative inbound impact with evidence and UNKNOWN default
  mcp Serve the MCP stdio interface
